author: CBR
description:
A Spider-Man: Brand New Day shot reminded fans of the diner scene from The Avengers and the Battle of New York—but the similarity was not intentional. Director Destin Daniel Cretton explains that the filmmakers simply wanted a shot from inside the diner looking out onto the street.
